protocol_status: Pre-registration. The screening ran on GPUs (main 5dc653b; follow-ups: mp-multinode C4m, C8m, C16m at 6fe428d; PD retries at 2d104e4, b7760b0 and 50d51d9); results are in docs/report/SCREENING_2026-11-10.md. The rounds have not run. Before round 1, freeze aml/src/bench/ (this file, slo_suites.py, protocol.sh, bench_stats.py, lb_proxy.py, node_tools.py, nixl_preflight.py) and docs/BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md in one commit with the chosen ROUND_LAYOUTS; publish every run, including invalid and aborted runs.
rule: A always. FP8: the eligible layout other than A with the highest R/isl8192-c32 output tok/s. NVFP4: the eligible one-node layout (D included) with the highest R/isl8192-c32 output tok/s. D x 2: when lambda*(W1, standard SLO) of scr-Dx2 >= 1.9 x that of scr-Dx1. Exact ties go to the layout listed first. A KV-bound or capacity-bound flag at the ranking point is reported next to the score with the peak KV usage and the peak of running requests; it never excludes a layout.
